title: The Mechanism of "Treating Different Diseases with the Same Treatment" by Qiangji Jianpi Decoction in Ankylosing Spondylitis Combined with Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Comprehensive Analysis of Multiple Methods.
authors: Zhang, Xuhong; Zhou, Lamei; Qian, Xian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药强脊健脾方治疗强直性脊柱炎合并炎症性肠病的机制，虽涉及DNA转录因子结合和分子对接，但核心是疾病共病与中药网络药理学，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) are prevalent autoimmune disorders that often co-occur, posing significant treatment challenges. This investigation adopts a multidisciplinary strategy, integrating bioinformatics, network pharmacology, molecular docking, and Mendelian randomization, to elucidate the relationship between AS and IBD and to investigate the potential mechanisms of traditional Chinese medicine formulations, represented by Qiangji Jianpi (QJJP) decoction, in treating these comorbid conditions. METHODS: We utilized databases to pinpoint common targets among AS, IBD, and QJJP decoction's active compounds through intersection analysis. Through Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway analyses, we mapped a network in Cytoscape, isolating critical targets. Molecular docking with AutoDock validated the affinity between targets and compounds. ROC analysis and dataset validation assessed diagnostic performance, while Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) offered pathway insights. Mendelian randomization explored the AS-IBD causal relationship. RESULTS: Screening identified 105 targets for QJJP decoction, 414 for AS, and 2420 for IBD, with 85 overlapping. These targets predominantly participate in organismal responses and DNA transcription factor binding, with a significant cellular presence in the endoplasmic reticulum and vesicle lumen. Molecular docking, facilitated by Cytoscape, confirmed IL1A, IFNG, TGFB1, and EDN1 as critical targets, with IFNG demonstrating diagnostic potential through GEO dataset validation. The integration of GSEA with network pharmacology highlighted the therapeutic significance of the relaxin, osteoclast differentiation, HIF-1, and AGE-RAGE signaling pathways in QJJP decoction's action. Mendelian randomization analysis indicated a positive causal relationship between IBD and AS, pinpointing rs2193041 as a key SNP influencing IFNG. CONCLUSION: Based on the principle of "treating different diseases with the same method" in traditional Chinese medicine theory, we explored the intricate mechanisms through which QJJP decoction addresses AS and IBD comorbidity. Our research spotlighted the pivotal role of the IFNG gene. IFNG emerges not only as a key therapeutic target but also assumes significance as a potential diagnostic biomarker through its genetic underpinnings. This investigation establishes a solid base for subsequent experimental inquiries. Our findings introduce novel approaches for incorporating traditional Chinese medicine into the treatment of AS-IBD comorbidity, setting the stage for groundbreaking research directions.
abstract_zh: 背景：强直性脊柱炎（ankylosing spondylitis, AS）和炎症性肠病（inflammatory bowel disease, IBD）是常见的自身免疫性疾病，常同时发生，给治疗带来重大挑战。本研究采用多学科策略，整合生物信息学、网络药理学、分子对接和孟德尔随机化，以阐明AS与IBD之间的关系，并探讨以强脊健脾（QJJP）方为代表的传统中药制剂治疗这些共病状态的潜在机制。方法：我们利用数据库，通过交集分析确定AS、IBD和QJJP方活性化合物之间的共同靶点。通过基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）通路分析，我们在Cytoscape中绘制网络，并分离出关键靶点。使用AutoDock进行分子对接，验证靶点与化合物之间的亲和力。ROC分析和数据集验证评估了诊断性能，而基因集富集分析（Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, GSEA）提供了通路见解。孟德尔随机化探讨了AS-IBD的因果关系。结果：筛选确定QJJP方有105个靶点，AS有414个，IBD有2420个，其中85个重叠。这些靶点主要参与生物体反应和DNA转录因子结合，在内质网和囊泡腔中具有显著的细胞存在。通过Cytoscape辅助的分子对接确认IL1A、IFNG、TGFB1和EDN1为关键靶点，其中IFNG通过GEO数据集验证显示出诊断潜力。GSEA与网络药理的整合强调了松弛素、破骨细胞分化、HIF-1和AGE-RAGE信号通路在QJJP方作用中的治疗意义。孟德尔随机化分析表明IBD与AS之间存在正向因果关系，并确定rs2193041为影响IFNG的关键SNP。结论：基于中医理论中“异病同治”的原则，我们探讨了QJJP方处理AS和IBD共病的复杂机制。我们的研究突出了IFNG基因的关键作用。IFNG不仅作为关键治疗靶点出现，而且通过其遗传基础，作为潜在诊断生物标志物具有重要意义。本研究为后续实验探究奠定了坚实基础。我们的发现为将传统中医药纳入AS-IBD共病治疗引入了新方法，为开创性研究方向铺平了道路。
